summary: Recovered the live authorities and bounded repair context. Prioritized backlog: (1) P0—make validated plans durable executable task graphs and eliminate duplicate/repeated queue materialization; evidence: core/projects/tasks/queue.jsonl:40001-40125 contains many repeated pending execute/verify projections for one objective, while :40222-40229 materializes the current dependency graph; human-visible result: one objective advances exactly one eligible leaf at a time across restart; smallest authority surface: existing arda-core queue contracts and Engine successor/reconciliation logic. (2) P0—bind every run to a truthful attached project contract and digest; evidence: data/workbench/projects.json:1-69 declares cargo test -p arda-core, while reviewed projects at :448-582 are read-only and separately rooted; human-visible result: every run shows its exact project, root, authority, and checks; smallest surface: existing project registry and Workbench project lookup/provenance. (3) P0—route execution and independent criticism through canonical Manwë placement rather than a fixed hosted route; evidence: docs/audits/2026-08-26-operator-vision-repair-backlog.md:80-118; human-visible result: selected/actual route, fallback reason, cost, and critic findings are visible; smallest surface: canonical task placement requirements, existing Manwë selection, Hermes adapter receipt binding, and Engine review transition. (4) P0—make continuation, approval scope/expiry, pause/cancel, retry, revision, replan, and wake scheduling durable; evidence: the backlog at :90-108 and queue revision records around queue.jsonl:40217-40229; human-visible result: exactly one next action and wake time with stale authority rejected; smallest surface: append-only continuation/approval records consumed by the existing executor and timer. (5) P1—retrieve bounded Vairë context and publish one truthful Hermes/HUD objective-control projection; evidence: ARDA_SYSTEM_STATUS_REPORT.md:47-50 and :119-131 identify context-use, Soterion retrieval, controls, real projects, and routing as open; human-visible result: a concise resume packet plus pause/reprioritize/revise/approve/reject/cancel controls over canonical records; smallest surface: Vairë capsule assembly, Engine operator projection, and existing interface consumers. (6) P1—activate daily improvement, proactive Personal Operations, external assimilation, and automatic source/installed/status reconciliation only through the same completion loop; evidence: docs/plans/ARDA_WHOLE_SYSTEM_COMPLETION_PROGRAM.md:75-93 and :99-112; human-visible result: quiet evidence-backed updates containing verified changes, justified no-change decisions, or concrete gates; smallest surface: existing Warden/Varda, governance, Personal Operations, assimilation, Workbench, and continuation boundaries. (7) P2—run whole-system acceptance only after P0/P1: one operator-authored objective spanning two real projects, restart, failure correction, distinct review, context return, and verified joined closure; evidence: AUTONOMOUS_TASK_COMPLETION_LOOP.md:23-37 and ARDA_WHOLE_SYSTEM_COMPLETION_PROGRAM.md:49-97; human-visible result: materially reduced remembering, assignment, checking, and recovery burden, judged by the operator. No files were modified or created, generated queue projections were untouched, and the verifier-owned cargo test check was not run.
